segments.text: Papists teach, that beside the written word, there be certaine vnwritten traditions, which must be beleeued as profitable and necessarie to saluation. And these they say are twofold; Apostolicall, namely such as were deliuered by the Apostles and not written; and Ecclesiasticall, which the Church decreeth as occasion is offered. We hold that the Scriptures are most perfect, containing in them all doctrines needfull to saluation, whether they concerne faith or manners: and therefore we acknowledge no such traditions beside the written word, which shal be necessarie to saluation: so as he which beleeueth them not cannot be saued.
